name: Open Anthology of Early World Literature in English Translation (Hrach and Koech, Columbus State University)
goodFor: A collection of early world literature in English translation, with multiple translations to compare.

evidence.quote: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-Share Alike 4.0 International License
A collection of free and open primary texts in digital formats for the study of early world literature in English translation.
A printable copy of this LibGuides-based open textbook is available as an additional file.

notes: The book's own page in the GALILEO repository states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. NonCommercial, and Ceder has paid plans, so an app only links to it. The page says it is a LibGuides-based open textbook with a printable copy as an additional file; the LibGuides site and the translations it gathers (which may carry their own licences) were not read.
